body.name: \Lambda_{\mathrm{pub}}
body.def: the observed-row block of \(L_{\mathrm{pub}}^{-\mathsf T}\), namely \(\Lambda_{\mathrm{pub}}=\begin{pmatrix}\gamma_1&1&0&0\\u\gamma_1+\gamma_2&u&1&0\\\beta(u\gamma_1+\gamma_2)+\gamma_3&\beta u&\beta&1\end{pmatrix}\), with rows indexed by observed nodes \(1,2,3\) and columns indexed by sources \(0,1,2,3\)
